title: Do these 4 every day this week when your knees are complaining
caption: No squat workout for the days your knees are complaining: Doorframe Row, Wall Push-Up, Glute Bridge, Lying Heel Tap. Two rounds of the four, eight minutes, and nothing that bends a knee under load. Save this for the day the stairs are talking to you.

overlays.text: Do these 4 every day this week when your knees are complaining.
Doorframe Row. 8 reps. Grip the frame, lean back, pull your chest to your hands.
Wall Push-Up. 10 reps. Hands on the wall, lower your chest, press yourself back out.
Glute Bridge. 10 reps. Lie on your back, feet flat, push your hips up.
Lying Heel Tap. 10 reps. Knees bent above your hips, tap one heel down and back.

scenes.footer: The squat comes back when your knees stop complaining.

overlays.text: No squat pattern this week. This is training what is fresh, not treatment.

scenes.footer: Ten minutes is complete. So is eight.

overlays.text: Two rounds of the four. Eight minutes, and nothing bends a knee under load.

scenes.footer: Save this for the day the stairs are talking to you.

overlays.text: Which one are you starting with?
